component.name: Filefind
component.summary: Find any file by what's inside it

description.p: Filefind is a fast, simple full-text search for your documents. Add the folders you care about, then type: results appear instantly as you type, even with typos.

ul.li: Searches inside PDF, Word, LibreOffice, Excel, PowerPoint, RTF, EPUB, HTML, Markdown and text files
Fuzzy matching forgives typos and accents
Keeps up with changes to your files automatically
Preview files with every match highlighted
Results also appear in GNOME and KDE system search
Filter by file type and date, and sort results
Quick preview with highlighted matches, tables and formatted Markdown
Search syntax: phrases, exclusions, type:, in: and name:
Results in GNOME and KDE system search
Finds other files by name, and matches other forms of a word
Faster indexing that stays out of your way
